title: turn.user
description: The caller's turn is over and this is what they said. With it, everything the session measured about the turn.

UserTurnEnded.description: The caller's turn is over and this is what they said. With it, everything the session measured about the turn.

speech_id.description: The id of the reply this turn triggers; turn.agent and its llm, tts and eou blocks carry the same id. That is the join.

item_id.description: The session's id for this message in the chat history.

text.description: The final transcript, or the message as typed.

language.description: The language heard, as a BCP 47 tag.

transcript_confidence.description: The recognizer's confidence, 0 to 1, when it reports one.
